name: Test A Randomizer Game v6.3
desc:
Test The Randomizer Game [TTRG], yep this is the full name but we'd rather call it "Test"
Whats interesting for me is always going to be here, at least I hope so

Keybind 
Q - Dash
B - Evasive (works when you have 100% evasive bar)
G - Ultimate
you can change the position of your weapon by holding the weapon slot

Liking the experience would help us a lot, thanks!
50% more XP on weekend

Have Fun!

Most of the Music came from other games such as Terraria Calamity mod, Library of Ruina and Etc. (please check those out as well)
